description: This file implements the SignalFd class for handling signal file descriptors, including setting up signal masks, reading signals, and managing file descriptors within the process sandboxer component.

classes.name: SignalFd
classes.description: A class that encapsulates a signal file descriptor, providing methods to set up signal masks, read signals, and access the underlying file descriptor.

methods.name: SignalFd
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SignalFd object with a file descriptor.

methods.name: AllExceptSigChld
methods.description: Creates a SignalFd object that listens for all signals except SIGCHLD.

methods.name: ReadSignal
methods.description: Reads a signal from the signal file descriptor and returns the signal info.
